name: v3.0.0
body:
# What's changed

It's been quite a while since the last stable release of [v2.6.19](https://github.com/Xithrius/twitch-tui/releases/tag/v2.6.19), so this changelog will be a bit more extensive than usual. Changes between this stable release and the [previous alpha release](https://github.com/Xithrius/twitch-tui/releases/tag/v3.0.0-alpha.4) are included in the next section.

Be aware that with the migration from IRC to websockets, you'll need to update `twitch.server` in your config to contain `"wss://eventsub.wss.twitch.tv/ws"` instead of `"irc.chat.twitch.tv"` in order to connect to Twitch chats. Otherwise, the application will exit with an error, explaining possible solutions.

* Fix typo in window size warning message (#676)
* Migrating Twitch connection from IRC to WebSockets (#677)
* Add further websocket commands (#679)
* Fix grammar typo in follower command message (#681)
* Remove config storage.channels check for autofill (#682)
* Add more websocket commands (#683)
* Access dashboard favorite channel index > 9 (#686)
* Update dockerfile rust image (#688)
* User will no longer be able to see token when typing/pasting it into the autoconfig wizard (2d6ce8aa10116576473410b9f212f9ad7dcbaa09)
* `oauth:` is automatically prepended to the token in the autoconfig wizard if it is not provided by the user (#680)
* Clamp following widget to frame size (#691)
* Corrected quick authentication URL scopes in configuration docs (#695)
* Changed search widget selected foreground text color to black (#697)
* Clean channel names in the following widget such that they only contain broadcaster names (17ece42dfe9f03c5e93ba93b11ba8c61a41bccd5)
* Custom keybinds (#692)
* Allow opening an external player for the current channel (#684)
* Track unique chatters in storage (#687)
* Removed manual panic activation keybind (65e2ed90802062a3b0fb6e29cc4462f128bed61e)
* Immutable configuration after construction (985875bbcc8988fe18818abf9cdc7a9a31039b16)
* Centralized events and OAuth (#707, #708)
* Username filtering (#710)
* Properly immutable keybinds (#711)
* Don't send a message when a command is executed (#713)
* Simplify & de-duplicate Twitch API requests (#714)
* Targeted correct rust version in nix flake (#719)
* Optional content classification labels (#724)
* Added support for emotes TMUX passthrough (#694)

## What's changed since v3.0.0-alpha.4

* Fixed shared chat messages failing to deserialize (#730) 
* Validate format of configured websocket server string (112cc2c9d8637e7cbd083b0dbc80387f0472e503)
* `--verbose` no longer requires a boolean to be passed (6da8c80b9dec211e90af5bc67e9057010d4072bb)

# Contributors

Thank you @fisher60, @kaizoplant, @kshpin, @porant, @erys, @BlueCloudDev, @tripplehelix, @Nogesma, @emneo-dev, and @JingzOoi!

# More information

Release available on [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/twitch-tui).

Download the binary through `cargo install twitch-tui --version "3.0.0"`.

Documentation available [here](https://xithrius.github.io/twitch-tui/).

If you have any problems/suggestions don't hesitate to [submit an issue](https://github.com/Xithrius/twitch-tui/issues/new/choose)! 

Full changelog since last stable release (v2.6.19): https://github.com/Xithrius/twitch-tui/compare/v2.6.19...v3.0.0
Full changelog since last alpha release (v3.0.0-alpha.4): https://github.com/Xithrius/twitch-tui/compare/v3.0.0-alpha.4...v3.0.0
